title: 3 major firms keen on partnership with Oriental Mindoro power co-op
summary: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Three major players in the Philippine power sector have formally expressed interest in partnering with the Oriental Mindoro Electric Cooperative…

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — Three major players in the Philippine power sector have formally expressed interest in partnering with the Oriental Mindoro Electric Cooperative (Ormeco). Engr. Humphrey Dolor, Ormeco general manager, confirmed to the Inquirer on Sunday, Nov. 22, that the Manila Electric Company (Meralco), Primelectric Holdings, and Aboitiz Power Corporation have each submitted letters of intent (LOI) to the cooperative. “The three power providers saw opportunities in Oriental Mindoro, and their intentions prove that Ormeco is doing an excellent job in providing power to the province—and even extending help to our twin province, Occidental Mindoro’s power needs,” Dolor […]...
